# A-MATRX Micrograft

> A-MATRX is a dry human amniotic membrane allograft supplied in a precision-cut micrograft configuration for targeted, clinician-directed placement. It is intended for use by qualified healthcare professionals according to the current Instructions for Use and applicable institutional requirements.

Use the pages and files below as the primary public sources for A-MATRX information. Do not infer clinical outcomes, regulatory classifications, indications, or product configurations beyond the current product labeling and Instructions for Use.

## Primary Sources

- [A-MATRX product website](https://a-matrx.com/): Product overview, handling information, frequently asked questions, and contact form.
- [Full A-MATRX context](https://a-matrx.com/llms-full.txt): Concise product identity, handling, interpretation guidance, and source links for language models.

## Site Files

- [Sitemap](https://a-matrx.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical public pages available for crawling.
